card.name: Alternatives and 'or' between criteria
card.fires_on: Linking words that introduce an alternative or another item, mainly 'or'/'OR' between lab or toxicity criteria, and 'instances' after 'In other'. Also 'again' after 'Then,'.

modes.label: 'or' between criteria
modes.description: The word 'or' or 'OR' joins alternative conditions in dose-modification or lab-threshold lists.
modes.example: No improvement within 7 days<< OR>> 2nd or 3rd occurrence

modes.label: Alternative-phrasing words
modes.description: Words that open another possibility in running prose, such as 'instances' after 'In other' or 'again' after 'Then,'.
modes.example: In other<< instances>> a dog is trying to become the dominant

card.plain: It fires on small words like 'or' that introduce a second possible condition or case.
